With the driver's seat belt fastened, the warning light remains on.

N.B.: The safety belt unfastened warning light is turned on by a command sent via the B-CAN from the "Air Bag Node" to the Body Computer. The latter sends the signal, via the B-CAN, to the Instrument Panel Node.

1

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

Connect the EXAMINER diagnostic tester and check on CAN NETWORK INFORMATION:

  • No control units inactive
  • No faulty control units
  • No control units with faulty CAN line;

Move on to Step 2

1. Fault on CAN network

1. Continue following the instructions for the diagnostic equipment

2. Impossible to communicate with the Body Computer

2. Move on to Step 8

Move on to Step 3
